01 Overview

Miller Heating & Air has served Denver homes since 1998. This proposal covers a complete furnace replacement for your home — not just a swap of the unit, but the full system: removal of the old furnace, installation of the new one, an inspection of your existing ductwork, commissioning of the completed system, and a maintenance visit during your first year of ownership. Our crews are licensed and insured, and every estimate is written and provided free of charge before any work begins.

02 Scope of Work

  • Removal and disposal of the existing furnace
  • Installation of the replacement furnace and connection to existing gas, electrical, and venting
  • Inspection of ductwork for leaks, sizing, and sealing needs
  • Full system commissioning and safety checks on the completed installation
  • Scheduled first-year maintenance visit following installation

03 What's Included

  • Free written estimate prior to any work
  • Licensed and insured installation crew
  • Duct inspection as part of the replacement, with sealing available if needed
  • One scheduled maintenance visit in the first year following installation
  • Financing available on approved credit
